تستشبون (form X)
# تَسْتَشِبُّونَ (tastašibbūna) /tas.ta.ʃib.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
# تُسْتَشَبُّونَ (tustašabbūna) /tus.ta.ʃab.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَشَبَّ (istašabba)
